title: 50 Cent bought Mike Tyson's mansion. It cost him $72,000 a month.
description:
He paid $4.1 million for it. Keeping it cost more than most people earn in a year — every year. The price of a thing is not what you pay for it.

New video every day.

scenes.say: In two thousand three, 50 Cent bought a mansion in Connecticut for four point one million dollars. He bought it from Mike Tyson.
Twenty one bedrooms. Twenty five bathrooms. Nine kitchens. Two pools, a basketball court and a helicopter pad.
Twelve years later his bankruptcy filing listed what it actually cost to keep.
Seventy two thousand dollars a month. Not the mortgage. Just keeping the lights on, the pools warm and the grass cut.
That is more every month than most people earn in a year. For a house nobody was living in.
He listed it at eighteen and a half million. It sold for two point nine.
The price of a thing is not what you pay for it. It is what you pay for it, plus what it costs to keep, minus whatever anyone will give you back.
